text:
```yaml
name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install setuptools wheel
        pip install -r requirements.txt
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a testing environment for the `m3dev/pptx-template` repository using Python versions 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13. It checks out the repository, sets up the specified Python version, installs the required dependencies, and runs the tests using `pytest`. This ensures that the project remains compatible with the new Python versions and that all tests pass before merging changes into the main branch.
